name: usage
description: Will this Cloudflare account stay inside its plan this billing period? A page, a JSON API and an MCP server on one Worker.

ANALYTICS_TOKEN.description: A Cloudflare API token with one permission, **Account Analytics: Read**. [Create it here](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/api-tokens&permissionGroupKeys=%5B%7B%22key%22%3A%22account_analytics%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22read%22%7D%5D&name=usage). For several accounts, separate the tokens with commas.

ACCESS_KEY.description: The password for your usage page, at least 24 characters. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores the usage readings, your settings and agent sign-ins.
